person_note: Cross sustains two base-narrative modes: Alex Cross narrates his chapters in first person, while separate chapters follow Michael Sullivan and other characters in third person. The authorized opening and q01386 support the first-person strand; the input quotes do not sample a diagnostic Sullivan passage, but the displayed consecutive chapters and multiple structural sources establish the third-person strand. Dialogue and gnomic quotations were not promoted to narrator evidence. Confidence is medium because the only Tier A source covers the opening, the Tier B source discusses the series rather than this book specifically, and the exact book-level third-person evidence comes from Tier C sources; therefore the evidence does not justify high confidence under the two-strong-source rule for an ALTERNATING label lacking full quote support.
